integrity: A self-contained combinatorial proof and a standalone finite falsification checker are supplied. No claim of global publication-priority certainty, external certification, or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary closed-neighborhood domination in the one-step product of two complete graphs; no assertion for arbitrary factors, iterated constructions, or different domination variants. Finite enumerations test instances and are not the infinite proof.
title: Fiber-profile domination of complete-graph Sierpiński products
